body:
Adds `research/chip-toolchain`: Yosys/Icarus/Verilator flow with recorded versions, gate count and depth for adders, a multiplier and a FIFO, SAT equivalence of two adders with a broken-adder control. 8 tests; `python site/build.py` prints ok. New `chip` theme added to the site. OpenROAD and cocotb are not covered (stated in the README).
